neighbours.label: the word just before a predictable P-initial word: typically the first word of an acronym's expansion when the acronym's next letter is P (IPM → 'Integrated' before 'Pest', NPS → 'National' before 'Park')
fire: The laptop has a faster CPU (Central Processing Unit) than the old one.

Choose a cream with a high SPF (Sun Protection Factor) for the beach.
The loan carries an APR (Annual Percentage Rate) of nine percent.
The startup announced its IPO (Initial Public Offering) last spring.
The vaccine protects against HPV (Human Papillomavirus) infection.
The reef was declared an MPA (Marine Protected Area) in 2010.
The engine idles at a low RPM (Revolutions Per Minute) when warm.
